name: sliplane
title: Sliplane
description: Search and manage your Sliplane services directly from Raycast.
author: Yulei Chen

commands.name: search-services
commands.title: Search Services
commands.description: Search and browse your Sliplane services across all projects.

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: Your Sliplane API token. Create one in Sliplane Dashboard under Team Settings.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
